meta.title: Ilya Abesadze — design services for digital products
meta.description: Product designer with 8+ years of experience: SaaS, B2B, B2C and enterprise interfaces, design systems, consulting and team training.

experience.title: Experience
experience.lead: 8+ years designing complex digital products: fintech, telecom, logistics and internal enterprise tools. I join teams at any stage, from discovery to design system support.

items.description: Checkout and payment flows used by millions of shoppers across Europe. Redesigned onboarding and dispute flows to reduce support load.

services.title: Services
services.lead: From research to a working design system: I help product teams ship complex interfaces faster and with fewer iterations.

image.alt: Mobile interface designed for the Ping proxy network

items.title: Interfaces design
items.description: Web and mobile interfaces for SaaS, B2B and enterprise products: user flows, prototypes, UI and handoff to development.

services.note: Every project starts with a free 30-minute call to align goals, scope and timeline.

knowledge.title: Additional knowledge
knowledge.lead: Beyond design, I work with analytics, AI tools and front-end code, so every decision is backed by data and easy to implement.
knowledge.note: Tools I use every day are listed in each card.

items.title: Product approach
items.description: User research, product metrics and A/B tests. Hotjar, Clarity and spreadsheets help validate every decision.

items.title: AI knowledge
items.description: AI-assisted research and prototyping with Cursor, Claude and ChatGPT to speed up delivery without losing quality.

items.title: Development knowledge
items.description: Vue, React, JavaScript and VS Code to design within real technical constraints and speak the developers’ language.

items.title: Languages
items.description: English, Russian and Italian. Comfortable working with international teams across time zones.

workFormats.lead: Pick the format that fits your product stage and budget.

items.title: fix price
items.description: Fixed budget and deadline for a clearly defined scope, such as an audit or MVP.
